name: Les Menuires
description: Les Menuires is the most affordable base in Les 3 Vallées at 1,850m. Purpose-built in the 1970s with functional concrete architecture, newer chalet-style hotels (Reberty, Les Bruyères) have improved the look. 94% visitor satisfaction. Famille Plus label. Unpretentious, cosmopolitan, family-friendly. Good links to Méribel and the full 600km 3V domain.

overview.atmosphere: Best-value base in Les 3 Vallées. Functional 1970s architecture with newer chalet-style additions. Awarded Famille Plus label. 94% visitor satisfaction.

beyond_skiing.non_ski_activities: Boukty Camp tobogganing, snow groomer rides, snowmobiling, dog sledding, meeting an alpine farmer, cinema, ski touring, cross-country skiing, heritage trail, Notre-Dame-de-la-Vie baroque sanctuary

villages.name: Les Menuires Centre (Croisette)
villages.character: Central area, functional 1970s architecture, shops, restaurants, services, Le Break sports centre

villages.name: Reberty
villages.character: Quieter satellite, newer chalet-style buildings, ski-in/ski-out

villages.name: Les Bruyères
villages.character: Quiet suburb, La Bulle aquatic centre, modern chalets

honest_drawbacks: Quieter apres than Méribel/VT (but Roc Seven lively)
